action: Iceland Review reports companies and institutions are being urged to review their defences and risk assessments.
date_note: Iceland Review (26 November) relays a RÚV report dated 25 November; the page gives no earlier day.
exec: Iceland's authorities activated a national plan for essential information infrastructure after a series of cyberattacks.
plain: Iceland's Civil Protection and CERT-IS activated a national plan to protect essential information infrastructure after a series of cyberattacks. Officials say there is no confirmed danger to the public.

sources.name: Iceland Review: Cyberattacks Trigger Iceland’s Critical-Infrastructure Response Plan

summary: Iceland Review, relaying RÚV, reports that Civil Protection and CERT-IS activated a national response plan for protecting essential information infrastructure after a series of cyberattacks. RÚV reports part of Reykjavík City's computer systems was attacked and the Blue Lagoon's booking system was affected. Officials say there is no confirmed danger to the public and that claims about who is behind the attacks remain unconfirmed.
title: Iceland activates national plan for essential information infrastructure after series of cyberattacks

validation.note: Iceland Review relays RÚV and officials' statements; RÚV and the authorities' own pages were not read.
